smoke.qualification: Task completion uses the recorded acceptance profile and includes physical recovery; strict clean success excludes deviations and recovery. Legacy clean counters use the recorded profile. Partial-source rate is coverage, not an estimated full-source result.

preflight_coverage.qualification: Initial physics preflight only; no complete task or rendering validation
